The relevant section of the DFVP Amendment Act states that “For this section, an expert on the subject of domestic violence includes a person who can demonstrate specialised knowledge, gained by training, study or experience, of a matter that may constitute evidence of domestic violence”. This is consistent with the common law position on the admissibility of expert evidence.
